_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base rate says 99% of 12h windows see <2 point moves and the analyst's own direction accuracy is 15.8% — this is a coil that holds, not a breaker visible yet, so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until ETF flows or VIX confirm a directional break.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing broken analog and coil dynamics; narrative writer implies directional mean reversion (UP) with high conviction citing bottom pattern match; I side with the analyst's higher trust weight and structural evidence over the narrative's pattern optimism
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows break above 30 AND btc_momentum_30d sustains above 55 with funding cooling below 45
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain below 15 AND VIX spikes above 70 with btc_momentum_30d rolling over below 45
